Heard learned counsel for the petitioners.
2. According to the petitioner, land belonging to him was submerged in water when the Pimpalgaon Joga Dam was constructed.

A representation was sent to the Deputy Collector of land acquisition,
who in his reply dated 5th March, 2024, referred to the records, and confirmed that land acquisition proceeding was not undertaken in respect of the subject land belonging to the petitioner.

3. In this backdrop, petitioner is praying for a direction to the respondents to initiate proceedings under the Right To Fair Compensation And Transparency In Land Acquisition, Rehabilitation And Suman Vitthal Pansare And Ors vs State Of Maharashtra Thr Principal ... on 6 January, 2026 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/29831888/
1 Resettlement Act, 2013, with regard to the subject land.
4.
